name: Diversity Visa (DV) Lottery

selection_odds.basis: Historically up to 55,000 visas/year (reduced to ~54,850 in some years by NACARA set-aside), 7% per-country cap. Program currently paused indefinitely — no DV-2027 registration has opened.

requirements.blocker_text: This historically required a qualifying country of birth (countries with historically low rates of immigration to the US are eligible; high-admission countries are excluded).
This historically required a high-school-equivalent education, or 2 years of qualifying work experience in an occupation requiring 2+ years of training.

outcome.duration_length: indefinite — direct green card on selection and approval (when operational)

sources.title: USCIS/DHS — Diversity Visa program pause directive, Dec 18, 2025 (following the Brown University/MIT shooting investigation)

notes: GENUINE NEW STATUS CASE for this dataset: 'paused' is distinct from both 'draft' (data incomplete) and 'closed' (permanently ended) as used elsewhere — the DV program is created by statute (INA §203(c)) and would require Congress to terminate permanently; this is an executive-branch pause, not a legal closure, and previously-issued DVs have not been revoked. Marked 'draft' as the closest fit in the current status enum (same limitation flagged on pt_job_seeker_skilled and jp_ikusei_shuro for different reasons) — this is the third distinct 'not fully operational despite not being closed' pattern found across this dataset, reinforcing that a dedicated 'paused' status value would be a worthwhile future schema addition. Paused Dec 18, 2025 following the Brown/MIT shooting investigation (the suspect had entered via DV-2017); DV-2026 selectees still face the statutory Sept 30, 2026 deadline; DV-2027 registration has NOT opened with no announced timeline; litigation ongoing (e.g. Ivanov v. Trump). A separate rule effective April 10, 2026 requires a valid passport bio-page scan and $1 fee for any future DV entries, layered on top of the pause itself.
